At that time, the Anglo-Iranian Co (later BP) was sucking up all of Iran's oil. In an effort to stop this thievery of the country's biggest natural resource and to spread the wealth among its impoverished citizens, the new PM proposed nationalizing Iran's oil. Fearing the loss of its cash cow, BP appealed to the US by painting this maneuver as communist. Quickly, the CIA was sent in to initiate a coup--imprisoning Mossadegh and installing the Shah. For the next 2 1/2 decades, the corrupt, exploitive autocrat hunted down the pro-democracy Iranians and had them tortured, imprisoned, exiled, or killed. The leftover anti-US sentiment was rekindled and rebranded by an opportunistic Islamic cleric as the activities of the "Great Satan" against the followers of Islam. In 1979, the shah flew off with suitcases of cash, US diplomats were taken hostage, revolution ensued, Khomeini was appointed Ayatollah, and the Islamic Republic of Iran was created.
